Type: bistro-style wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, classic, minimalist
Materials: solid wood frame with a white painted finish, curved wooden backrest
Colors: white, soft off-white
Shape: wide curved backrest panel on two rear posts, rounded seat, four slim round legs joined by a ring stretcher, bentwood café look, light and open
Feel: bright, airy, simple, friendly
Goes with: white or light wood tables, pastel or grey walls; Scandinavian kitchens, cottage or bright dining rooms
